description: List all countries by their GDPR transfer status — EU/EEA (free flow), adequate protection (Art. 45 adequacy decision), SCC required (Art. 46), or blocked by organizational policy. Use this to check a country's status before initiating a transfer, or to show a user which countries require additional safeguards.

filter.description: Filter countries by transfer status. Defaults to 'all'.

name: list_adequate_countries
